summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of VISUWORKS premium German website completed. All 12+ pages, SEO, CookieBanner, ChatWidget, TeamPage, NotFoundPage, ProjektePage with filters/skeletons, Testimonials carousel, Newsletter signup, Footer, and mobile responsiveness - all working correctly.
passed_tests: Homepage renders all sections: Hero, ClientLogos, Services, Projects Preview, Process, Target Audiences, Statistics, Testimonials, Newsletter, CTA, Footer
SEO: document.title updates correctly for all 12 pages (Home, Mobilität, Architektur, Markenkommunikation, Design, Projektmanagement, Projekte, Kontakt, Team, Impressum, Datenschutz, AGB)
SEO: og:title and og:description meta tags present and correct on all pages

CookieBanner: appears on first visit after 1.5s delay, shows settings view with toggles, accept all/reject/save preferences work, disappears after selection, does not reappear on reload (localStorage key: visuworks_cookie_consent)
ChatWidget: floating green button visible after 2s animation, opens popup with WhatsApp/Phone/Email links on click, closes on second click
TeamPage (/team): renders 4 team members with names, roles, bio; 4 company values; 5 LinkedIn links; company info section with 15 years experience
NotFoundPage: shows 404 page for invalid routes (/nonexistent-page-12345), displays 'Seite nicht gefunden', has Home and Back buttons, quick links (Projekte, Mobilität, Kontakt)
Projekte page (/projekte): filter tabs work (Alle, Mobilität, Architektur, Kommunikation, Event, Design), 18 project cards displayed, cards link to case studies
Testimonials carousel: prev/next buttons cycle through testimonials, dot indicators visible, content changes correctly
Newsletter signup: validates email (shows error for invalid), shows loading state (spinner), shows success state ('Vielen Dank! Sie wurden erfolgreich angemeldet.')
Footer: has navigation links (services, company, legal), newsletter minimal form, social links (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube)
Navigation: all page links work correctly
Mobile hamburger menu: works on mobile viewport (390x844), opens and displays all nav items
Statistics section displays CountUp animated values (500+ Projekte, 15 Jahre Erfahrung, 98% Kundenzufriedenheit, 12 Länder)

mocked_apis.Newsletter signup: Simulated with setTimeout (1.5s delay) - shows success state

context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features tested and working. SEO uses custom useEffect-based solution (not react-helmet). CookieBanner uses localStorage key 'visuworks_cookie_consent'. ChatWidget has 2s animation delay. Newsletter and contact forms are MOCKED with setTimeout. Dark theme background is #070910. All content is in German. Framer Motion animations working correctly.
